title.narrative: "Integrated Multisectoral assistance to support drought affected communities in Oromia region (Gumbi Bordode woreda)- Priority 1"

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtIn 2023, the overall humanitarian situation in Ethiopia is remarkably deteriorated. Multiple overlapping humanitarian crises such as ongoing latent conflicts, widespread of violence and climate shocks including prolonged drought and floods, have increased significantly the humanitarian needs. The HRP 2024 targets more than 15.5 million people in Ethiopia that are in need of humanitarian assistance. Climate shocks, including drought and floods are still threatening the life of vulnerable people and restricted access to basic needs and services in several zones of the country. ltbrgtThe project targets Oromia regions and specifically Gubmi Bordede Woreda, due to the hughe humanitarian needs caused by the compounded effects of the drought and cholera. For the implementation of the project, MCMDO and COOPI will join the forces to ensure a multi-sectoral and integrated response in alignment with the 1st standard allocation of EHF, covering the sectors of Health, Nutrition, Agriculture and WASH, Protection and MPC to address needs of drought affected communities. ltbrgtThe project has been identified and designed jointly by MCMDO and COOPI. MCMDO, lead applicant, will coordinate, facilitate and liaise with the donor for the smooth implementation of the whole program as well as of the activities related to Health and Nutrition and COOPI will be in charge of implementing WASH and Agriculture. Protection will be mainstreamed by both organizations along with MEAL as cross cutting activities appropriately. The role and responsibility of each partner will be clearly defined through a formal partnership agreement that will bring greater impact on the wellbeing of targeted beneficiaries. The integrated intervention will address health needs by focusing on the provision of essential Primary health care services through MHNTs and strengthening system including Maternal and child health, strengthening routine and emergency immunization, support and strengthen surveillance activities and prevention and management of communicable diseases, capacity building of government health care providers, Risk communication and Community engagement, supporting the full functionality of health facilities through provision of medicines and medical supplies, minor health facilities repair and furnishing. The Nutrition section plans to provide lifesaving nutrition interventions by the integration of CMAM and IYCF-E activities through the existing health system. ltbrgtOn another side, the intervention will ensure the access to safe water for 14,055 people who will have access to safe drinking water through durable solution ensuring at the same time access to sanitation facilities in institutions such as schools and health facilities, and access to hygiene messaging and improved hygiene practices. This will be enforced by the distribution of WASH-NFI including WTC and hygiene awareness creation. ltbrgtThe Protection mainstreaming across the sector will include risk mitigation, and provision of GBV services, strengthening essential services for survivors of GBV, including case management and psychosocial support services. Whereas, the agriculture sector major activities include: provision of agricultural inputs, livestock veterinary drugs and multi-purpose cash for the targeted groups. Moreover, the MPC, aimed at protecting dignity of beneficiaries, allowing them to prioritize their critical unmet need and complementing the other sectoral intervention. Furthermore, the consortium will ensure strong coordination with other humanitarian partners in the Cluster System and the people-centered approach that will be key to ensure that the humanitarian response is meaningful and address the needs of the targeted population in a multi-sectoral approach. ltbrgtFinally, the project will target 44,446(20,904 Women, 7,679 Girls, 8536 Men and 7327 Boys) beneficiaries for the period of 12 months with a total budget of USD 1,000,000.00. ltbrgtlt/pgt
